'''Kenyon Elletson''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Tucson tournament]] on 24 June 2000 with Jedi Test retrieval, according to Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d945">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-it-has-a-cute-buttd945/ it-has-a-cute-butt], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 26 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-it-has-a-cute-buttd945/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
